method: Enumerated the pinned checkout tracked paths; reviewed rg searches for ring/tier semantics, ruleset/fixture consumers, seeded generators, catalog hashes/lengths, accessible title/navigation layouts, upkeep thresholds and e2e helpers. Matches mark files for disposition; nominal labels do not make the files active callers.

unchangedScopeNotes.why: Three physical outside rings; spec adds no outside plots.
Outside ring type and parser stay on 1–3. SOCIETY_TRIAL initial wall is still ring 1.
Outside ring grouping remains 1–3 and reads the expanded wall only as a threshold.
Existing generic lock, tier and dynamic ordered-map validations continue with the factory data; explicit checkpoint integrity guard is separately proposed.
Housing only counts the catalog housing property. Both named homes have npcBeds and no housing field.
Production scenario, byte equality, Hospital fault injection and existing timeout stay pinned.
Reuse the scenario and exact output format. Write a prospective copy through the new approved path-diff tool and retain the original generator.
Its counting and picker helpers derive from observed maps rather than literal 7/33/63 pins. The separate locked-card exact check is proposed.
The four-width reflow, existing help copy and fallback-font controls keep the same exact assertions and breakpoints.
Ring 3 stays the last outside ring. Existing narrow and desktop overflow checks continue.
Four-width title and 320px ledger layout thresholds stay in force; only paths to playable v11 fixtures change.
Direct weekly test fixture clears all buildings and isolates unrelated arithmetic, so the exact values stay.
Secondary test pins its current-ruleset literal. Its historical v9 refusal remains unchanged.
The building catalog union naturally grows from 32 to 37. The inspector explicitly enumerates nine tuning entries. B1 retains that curated list and the tuning row-count pin.
